name: 奥地利红白红卡—紧缺职业技术工人
nameEn: Austria Red-White-Red Card — Skilled Workers in Shortage Occupations
summary: 面向具备紧缺职业培训、合资格工作邀请并达到积分要求的第三国技术工人。
summaryEn: For third-country skilled workers with shortage-occupation training, a qualifying job offer and sufficient points.

jobOffer.summary: 须按具体路线确认是否需要合资格、匹配且符合当地条件的工作邀请。
jobOffer.summaryEn: The specific route determines whether a qualifying, matching job offer under local conditions is required.

qualification.summary: 须满足该路线适用的学历、培训、经验或职业条件。
qualification.summaryEn: The route-specific education, training, experience or occupation requirements must be met.

assessment.summary: 须按申请时官方规则完成积分、薪资、清单或劳动力市场等审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any points, salary, list or labour-market assessment in force when applying must be met.

sources.title: Austria Red-White-Red Card — Skilled Workers in Shortage Occupations
